test_title: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper (Held On: 12th September 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

The boss **asked to the reportee to submit the document**.

options.text: asked the reportee that submit the document
requested the reportee to submit document
asked the reportee to submit the document
told to the reportee submit document

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "asked to the reportee" is incorrect due to the inclusion of "to" after "asked." The verb "ask" does not take "to" when followed by a direct object.
 
• The correct construction should be "asked the reportee to submit the document," which is grammatically accurate.
 
• Option 3 provides the correct replacement, as it eliminates the unnecessary "to" and ensures proper sentence structure.
 
• Other options either have incorrect grammar or fail to convey the intended meaning appropriately.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The boss asked the reportee to submit the document."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "asked the reportee that submit the document" – Incorrect because "that submit" is grammatically wrong.
 
• **Option 2:** "requested the reportee to submit document" – Incorrect because while "requested" can be used, the original sentence specifies "asked." Additionally, "document" should ideally have an article (e.g., "the document").
 
• **Option 4:** "told to the reportee submit document" – Incorrect because "told to" is not the correct grammatical structure.
